note: Provenance for docs/contract.json. VCF Automation is not covered by the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0), so no published machine-readable specification exists for these operations. Every entry below is an HTML reference page on the Broadcom Developer Portal (xAPIs) that was read by hand to transcribe the contract.
apiProduct: VM Apps Org - Deployment (VCF Automation API)
retrievalMethod: manual read of the rendered xAPIs reference pages

sources.documents: Broadcom Developer Portal xAPIs product catalog; establishes that VCF Automation ships as a family of API products (VCF Automation - Administration / - Consumption) and names the 'VM Apps Org - Deployment' product used here.
sources.usedFor: product discovery; confirming no OpenAPI specification is published for VCF Automation

sources.documents: Landing page for the VM Apps Org - Deployment API product; API title and version selector (9.1 latest, 9.0 also offered).
Security schemes for the VCF Automation API: scheme name 'bearerAuth', type http, scheme bearer, bearer format JWT, carried in the standard 'Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>' header.
Operation index for the VM Apps Org - Deployment API; full method+path listing including the deployment actions and deployment requests endpoints.
sources.usedFor: confirming exact path templates for both contract operations and confirming which sibling endpoints exist but are deliberately out of scope

sources.documents: GET /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/actions - 'Returns the complete list of available actions that can be performed on a given deployment'. Path parameter deploymentId (string, required); no query parameters; bearerAuth; 200 returns an array of resource action objects with fields actionType, dependents, description, displayName, formDefinition{formURI,trackProgressInModal}, id, name, orgId, projectId, schema, valid; errors 401, 404.

GET /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/actions/{actionId} - returns a single ResourceAction. Supplies the per-field descriptions for the ResourceAction schema, notably valid: 'Resource action is valid for current state' and actionType: 'Resource action type. Possible values are : RESOURCE_ACTION, RESOURCE_EXTENSION,'.
sources.usedFor: field-level semantics of ResourceAction.valid, which is the gate condition in contract.gating

sources.documents: POST /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/requests - submits a deployment action request. Path parameter deploymentId (string, required); no query parameters; application/json body of type ResourceActionRequest with three properties actionId (string), inputs (object) and reason (string), none of them required; 200 returns a Request object whose required fields are completedTasks, createdAt, name, requestedBy and totalTasks, and whose optional fields include actionId, approvedAt, blueprintId, cancelable, catalogItemId, completedAt, deploymentId, details, dismissed, estimatedCompletionTime, id, initializedAt, inputs, outputs, resourceIds, resources, status, updatedAt; errors 401, 403, 404, 409.
sources.usedFor: contract operation submitDeploymentActionRequest (the mutating call) and its request body shape

sources.documents: The same 'Submit Deployment Action Request' operation as re-published under the VM Apps Org - Catalog product; enumerates Request.status values CREATED, PENDING, INITIALIZATION, CHECKING_APPROVAL, APPROVAL_PENDING, USER_INTERACTION_PENDING, INPROGRESS, COMPLETION, APPROVAL_REJECTED, ABORTED, SUCCESSFUL, FAILED.
sources.usedFor: cross-check of the POST body shape and the Request.status enumeration

sources.documents: Org Management - VM Apps Org overview; lists the VCF Automation operation groups for a VM Apps organization (including 'VM Apps Org - Deployment') and shows the tenant token endpoint used to mint the JWT presented to these APIs.
sources.usedFor: situating the Deployment API inside VCF Automation 9.1 and confirming the bearer token origin
